method_note: analyze_waste is called with detector= as the only variable. Dedup, crop padding, preprocessing, the confidence gate, the non-waste gate and the taxonomy mapping are production code, identical for both models. Nothing was retrained and no weights or configuration were modified.

taco_test_heldout.source: TACO human annotations, read from existing label files; none created here.

taco_val_realworld_80.source: TACO human annotations, read from existing label files; none created here.

performance.note: Detector only. The classifier, LangGraph and every LLM provider are not invoked.

false_positive_probe.basis: No annotated non-waste image set exists in this project. These regions are labelled by the COCO detector itself at >=0.45 confidence, not by a human, which is a weaker basis than the TACO ground truth used elsewhere in this report.

visual_examples.note: Annotated from the recorded per-object results, not re-inferred.

production_bug_found.what: _decode_image returned RGB; ultralytics treats a bare ndarray as BGR.
production_bug_found.note: Both A and B were measured again after the fix; the headline tables are post-fix.
